lessons.title: Testing the new generation of AI-enabled fire-extinguishing drones
lessons.title_zh: 測試具備人工智慧功能的新一代滅火無人機

paragraphs.en: In the mountains of Colorado, firefighters in Aspen are learning to operate a new type of drone designed to fight wildfires. Created by a California company named Seneca, these large black-and-white machines look like giant insects and are about the size of a small trailer. While drones have monitored fires for decades, these new devices use artificial intelligence to help extinguish them. When the program officially begins, Aspen could become the first fire department in the world to fly them independently.
paragraphs.zh: 在科羅拉多州的山區，阿斯彭（Aspen）的消防員正在學習操作一種專為撲滅野火而設計的新型無人機。這些黑白相間的大型機器由一家名為塞內卡（Seneca）的加州公司製造，外觀就像巨大的昆蟲，大小約莫相當於一輛小型拖車。雖然消防員使用無人機監測火災已有數十年之久，但這些新裝置利用人工智慧來協助撲滅火勢。當該計畫正式展開時，阿斯彭可能會成為全球第一個獨立操作這些無人機的消防部門。

paragraphs.en: The drones are built to work together in groups. Five of them can transport hundreds of gallons of fire-suppressing foam to remote locations that are hard for humans to reach, such as areas hit by lightning. According to Seneca's founder, Stuart Landesberg, an onboard system powered by artificial intelligence can measure wind speed and distance. It then drops water or flame retardant at the right angle and speed to put out lingering flames at a much lower cost than helicopters.
paragraphs.zh: 這些無人機被設計成能夠成群協同作業。五架無人機就能運送數百加侖的滅火泡沫到人類難以到達的偏遠地點，例如遭受雷擊的區域。根據塞內卡創辦人史都華・蘭德斯伯格（Stuart Landesberg）的說法，一個由人工智慧支援的機載系統能夠測量風速與距離。接著，它會以適當的角度和速度投放水或阻燃劑來撲滅殘存的火苗，而成本遠低於直升機。

paragraphs.en: Aspen Fire plans to spend about 2.5 million dollars over five years, funded by private donors. However, some experienced firefighters urge caution. Joe Stutler, a veteran firefighter with nearly six decades of experience, likes the idea of using drones at night when regular aircraft cannot fly. Still, he remains skeptical because the drones have only been tested during controlled burns, not on real wildfires. "I haven't seen any results," he noted, asking for solid data before celebrating.
paragraphs.zh: 阿斯彭消防局計劃在未來五年花費約兩百五十萬美元，費用由民間捐款者資助。然而，一些經驗豐富的消防員呼籲保持謹慎。擁有近六十年經驗的資深消防員喬・斯圖特勒（Joe Stutler）很認同在一般常規飛機無法飛行的夜間使用無人機的想法。儘管如此，他仍持懷疑態度，因為這些無人機只在計畫性引火燃燒中測試過，尚未應用於真正的野火。「我還沒看到任何結果，」他指出，並要求在慶祝前先拿出確切的資料。

paragraphs.en: Safety rules are also strict. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) recently granted a waiver allowing Aspen Fire to fly the drones up to 200 feet in Pitkin County. Firefighters cannot fly them over crowded neighborhoods, and an observer must watch the drones at all times. If this experimental project succeeds, local officials hope to expand their permit and assist in fighting fires across the state.
paragraphs.zh: 安全法規也相當嚴格。美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）最近核准了一項豁免，允許阿斯彭消防局在皮特金郡（Pitkin County）將無人機飛行至兩百英尺高。消防員不能讓無人機飛越人口稠密的社區，且必須始終有人監控無人機。如果這項實驗性計畫成功，地方官員希望能擴大許可範圍，並協助撲滅全州各地的火災。

grammar.explain: 句首使用過去分詞片語形成分詞構句，省略了連接詞與主詞，修飾主要子句的主詞 these large black-and-white machines。
grammar.example: Created by a California company named Seneca, these large black-and-white machines look like giant insects and are about the size of a small trailer.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: to help 引導的不定詞片語用來說明主要動詞 use 的目的，回答「為了做什麼」。
grammar.example: While drones have monitored fires for decades, these new devices use artificial intelligence to help extinguish them.

grammar.explain: 關係副詞 when 在此引導形容詞子句，用來修飾前面的先行詞時間名詞 night。
grammar.example: Joe Stutler, a veteran firefighter with nearly six decades of experience, likes the idea of using drones at night when regular aircraft cannot fly.
